name: axle-cad-engine
description: Build parametric CAD models in JavaScript, run them on your own machine, and get the same verdict axlekeys.com gives — offline, in about 55ms.

interface.shortDescription: Run Axle Keys model code locally and get the platform's verdict.
interface.longDescription: The real execution path behind axlekeys.com, packaged to run on your own machine: build parametric CAD from JavaScript, get the same deterministic verdict the hosted platform gives, and export STEP/STL. Ships the workflow skills that drive the hosted platform over MCP.
defaultPrompt: Build this model locally and show me the verdict.
Rebuild on every save while I edit the parameters.
